summary: VERIFIED: Italian 'Vatican News — Italiano' radio station has been swapped to 'Radio Mater'. Backend /api/library/radio returns radio-mater (name 'Radio Mater', language Italian, stream https://s2.shoutitaly.com/listen/radiomater/radio.mp3) and no longer contains slug 'vatican-news-italian' or any station whose name matches Vatican News + Italian. The Italian set is now exactly {radio-mater, radio-maria-italia, radio-maria-canada}. Frontend Library > Radio shows a Radio Mater card, no Vatican News — Italiano card; tapping Radio Mater switches it to ON AIR with the bottom mini-player showing 'Radio Mater — Live · On Air', no error banner and zero console errors. Regression: tapping Radio Maria Italia goes ON AIR cleanly; Vatican News — English goes to BUFFERING (network-stage, no error). All stream_urls are HTTPS. 9/9 pytest assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: backend log shows reload triggered by a working file '_swap_vatican_it.py' at /app/backend — main agent may want to remove that ad-hoc swap script from the backend directory so it doesn't ship or trigger reloads.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test_feat_aug25 session token; backend seed already contains Radio Mater in /app/backend/library_seed_data.py and prior runtime swap removed the vatican-news-italian doc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Italian Catholic radio swap fully verified end-to-end (iter 57). Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_radio_mater_iter57.py covers: Radio Mater present (list + detail), vatican-news-italian gone (slug + name + no vaticannews stream on any IT station), exact Italian set {radio-mater, radio-maria-italia, radio-maria-canada}, English & Spanish regression, all HTTPS.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was the previously-seeded 'Vatican News — Italiano' station pointing to https://radio.vaticannews.va/stream-it, which is Vatican's general 'Radio Vaticana Italia' channel that mixes secular pop music + Italian DJ talk — not appropriate for a Catholic radio feature. Fix verified: the seed doc was repurposed to 'Radio Mater' (slug radio-mater, stream https://s2.shoutitaly.com/listen/radiomater/radio.mp3) — Italian 24/7 Catholic station (rosary, Mass, adoration). The legacy vatican-news-italian doc is no longer returned by /api/library/radio and the Radio screen no longer shows that card. No mitigation needed.
